headline_en: Oil spikes to $90 on Middle East strikes, weighing on NVDA (UPTREND) futures pre-open

Biggest risk today is further escalation in Middle East driving oil and yield moves higher

market_mood.explanation_en: The market feels like a boat making slow progress against a mild headwind. At 75.6 the regime score says conditions are positive enough to own stocks but not strong enough to ignore risk management.
